name: sdl3
description: Switch build: builds devkitPro's SDL3-for-Switch fork (devkitPro/SDL@switch-sdl-3.4, commit c329016) from source via NINTENDO_SWITCH, since no prebuilt devkitPro switch-sdl3 portlib exists yet. version-date tracks the pinned commit's date, not an upstream SDL3 release number; keep it in sync with the REF/SHA512 in portfile.cmake.

vulkan.description: No-op on Switch (Vulkan is disabled); the devkitPro SDL3 build already provides whatever backends it supports.
